notes.title: Elroy's Soundtrack OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Dear adventurers! 


Immerse yourself in over an hour of original music by award-winning composer and music producer Martin Bezjak, created to accompany the wonderfully heartfelt journey of Elroy and Peggie across time and space. 🎸



This 38-track score blends lush orchestral ambiences, dark Americana textures, emotionally charged melodies, and heart-pounding cinematic climaxes.



From subtle moments to grand storytelling peaks, the soundtrack captures the full emotional arc of the game. ❤️



Also featured are two original songs co-written by Tadej Gregorcic:

🎵 "Crimson Sky" feat. Malidah

🎵 "Desert Man" feat. Žan Videc



With special guest Luka Šulić on cello. 🎻

Carefully mastered for premium listening in both MP3 and 24-bit FLAC formats.

[hr][/hr]Video: Martin Bezjak and Danilo Kapel from Epix Soundworks tell the story behind the creation of Elroy's rich soundscape.[previewyoutube="4iVYrzT-sAo;full"][/previewyoutube][hr][/hr]


💡 Enjoy a special 25% launch discount during the first two weeks after release!  



Let us know how you like the music in the Steam Discussions forum!

 

Thanks for listening!
- Team Elroy

notes.title: Elroy and the Aliens is OUT NOW! 🚀
notes.content:
"It's very rare that you get a chance to become part of a story ... and sometimes what you find makes it all worth it." — Peggie Wolfe, Elroy and the Aliens

Friends! 👋

At Motiviti, we began this journey more than a decade ago as a small team with big dreams. Today, we're proud to present to you our hand-drawn adventure game Elroy and the Aliens! 🛸

🎥 Launch Trailer

[previewyoutube=CaPFEa4QJ0w;full][/previewyoutube]

🕹️ Game Features

Set in the year 1993, the game follows Elroy, a young rocket engineer haunted by the mysterious disappearance of his archaeologist father. Joined by Peggie, a sharp-witted investigative journalist with a particular knack for languages, Elroy embarks on an odyssey from Slope City to a strange alien planet in search of the truth.


A story-driven point-and-click adventure game for both modern and classic audiences, set in an altered version of the 1990s with intelligent robots, paranormal activities and an ancient archaeological mystery.
 Multiple playable characters.
 Intriguing and challenging puzzles.
 Story full of mystery, character development, ancient legends, alien language and occasional pop culture references.
 Spanning 2 planets, 60 locations and featuring more than 60 characters.
 High-resolution, hand-drawn 2D art and animations with an old-school vibe and modern polish.
 Fully-voiced characters and original music score for an immersive movie-like experience.
 Designed with accessibility in mind with helpful captions for color-based puzzles, subtitles, and different input options.
 Approx. 10+ hours of gameplay, depending on your playing style.


⭐ Price + Launch Discount

The game is available on Steam for $17.99.

Enjoy a special 10% launch discount during the first two weeks after release! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1082190/Elroy_and_the_Aliens/

If you like the game, please consider leaving a review on Steam. It truly helps a lot. 🙏

A sincere thank you to all of you who have been part of this journey and supported us along the way! ❤️ 

See you in Slope City, and safe travels though the cosmos! 🚀

-Team Elroy

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40790167/2ca9cb45d4c24deacd638f35f9e848d6efb087c3.png

notes.title: Blasting off: Elroy and the Aliens Launches on April 2nd!
notes.content:

🎯 Mark Your Calendars

Yes! Elroy and the Aliens is coming to Steam on April 2nd, 2025. 
Sharpen your wits and get your clicking fingers warm and ready! 
We'll be pushing the release button at: 18:00 CET / 5 pm GMT / 9 am PT / 12 pm ET.

🎬 Sneak Peek

To help make the wait a bit easier, here is a fresh clip taken directly from the game. 
Elroy (voiced by Jay Rincon) and Peggie (voiced by Dev Joshi) arrive at Crazy Fred's diner in a desert ghost town. Featuring also: an old banjo, a beaten-up Telecaster, and a rusty slide guitar — the perfect musical backdrop for a dusty desert stop, composed and arranged by Martin Bezjak from Epix Soundworks. 🌵

[previewyoutube=UpLmuCS_x-M;full][/previewyoutube]

Set in the year 1993, the game follows Elroy, a young rocket engineer haunted by the mysterious  disappearance of his archaeologist father. Joined by Peggie, a sharp-witted investigative journalist with a particular knack for languages, Elroy embarks on an odyssey from Slope City to a strange alien planet in search of the truth.


 A story-driven point-and-click adventure game for both modern and classic audiences, set in an altered version of the 1990s with intelligent robots, paranormal activities and an ancient archaeological mystery.

 Multiple playable characters.

 Intriguing and challenging puzzles.

 Story full of mystery, character development, ancient legends, alien language and occasional pop culture references.

 Spanning 2 planets, 60 locations and featuring more than 60 characters.

 High-resolution, hand-drawn 2D art and animations with an old-school vibe and modern polish.

 Fully-voiced characters and original music score for an immersive movie-like experience.

 Designed with accessibility in mind with helpful captions for color-based puzzles, subtitles, and different input options.

 Approx. 10+ hour of gameplay, depending on your playing style.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40790167/b64c471c9a58576a39ee2ef422592540ab10eefb.png

🛒 Launch Price + Discount

The game will be available on Steam for $17.99.
 
There are so many of you who have been patiently waiting and supporting us through all those years. As a thank you, we're setting up a launch discount of 10% for the first two weeks after release! 

Friends, we couldn't have done it without you!❤️
See you in Slope City on April 2nd! 

-Team Elroy

notes.title: Play Elroy's Top Rated Demo on Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
Hey Friends! Time to play the Demo on Steam Next Fest (Feb/24th - Mar/3rd) starting today!
Thank you so much for all your overwhelmingly amazing reviews so far! 😍

What's in the Demo? 

Here's a little side-questy sneak peek! :) 

[previewyoutube=v9gjmnh4QlQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Game Features

🎭 A story-driven point-and-click adventure game for both modern and classic audiences, set in an altered version of the 1990s with intelligent robots, paranormal activities, and an ancient archaeological mystery.

🎨 High-resolution, hand-drawn 2D art and animations with an old-school vibe and modern polish.

🔊 Fully-voiced characters by A-list actors in English (such as Jay Rincon, Dev Joshi and many others) and an original music score (composed by Martin Bezjak and Epix Soundworks) for an immersive movie-like experience.

🧩 Intriguing and challenging puzzles.

🪐 Spanning 2 planets, 60 locations, and featuring more than 60 characters.

👥 Multiple playable characters.

📝 Subtitles in German (by Marcel Weyers), Spanish (by Concha Fernández Álvarez), French (by Christophe Pallarès), Portuguese-Brasil (by Rômulo Wehling) and English as the original language.

The Game's Mission

Why did we start hand-crafting Elroy 11 years ago? We wanted to revive that special feeling that happens only once, when you're a kid. When the eyes are wide open and full of wonder. When you're sitting in the living room on a Saturday morning and play THAT game on your parents' PC for the first time.  🤩

Demo Feedback

If you'd like to share your thoughts or feedback on the Demo with us, we have a nifty Steam Forum thread right here for you. Also, we'll keep the Demo live after Next Fest so you can try it when it suits you.

What's Next?

The countdown has begun! Elroy and the Aliens is launching 37 days from today, on April 2nd, 2025! 🚀

You've been suggesting and we've been listening! 🙌 We've been making improvements all along to make Elroy the best point & click adventure game we can. The game is now 99.9908% complete! We will keep polishing the cutlery to be 100% ready when we invite you to dig in and get the game fresh and hot on it's release on April 2nd!   

You'd like to keep in touch with us? Follow Elroy on Bluesky, X or join our Discord! We love to chat. 

Thank you! ❤️

- Team Elroy

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3144250/Elroy_and_the_Aliens_Demo/
